thread:
sofia: Quick ask — embeddings v2.3.1 is causing 50-150ms p99 increase in prod. Need a 1-hour change window exemption to pin back to v2.2.9 while we investigate. Can we get a quick go/no-go?

matt: timeline? is this customer impacting?

sofia: Yep, started ~08:12 UTC. Affecting 3% of traffic, APM traces show KV cache miss spike. Customers are seeing slower search latencies. Hoping to pin for 1h max and run canary then rollback if stable.

jen: +1 to pin. Do we have a rollback playbook ready? links?

sofia: Rollback steps in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-rollback
Command to pin: `deploybot pin --env prod --svc embeddings --version v2.2.9 --duration 60m`

deploy-bot: @sofia requested pin for service=embeddings version=v2.2.9 duration=60m by actor=sofia. Queueing canary job.

amanda: if canary passes, what's the promotion plan? gradually 10/30/100?

sofia: Start 5% canary for 15m, if p95 and error rate stable then 50% for 15m, then full. Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% above baseline or p95 > +200ms.

sam: Metrics to watch: embeddings p95 latency, downstream search latency, error rate, and KV hit ratio. I'll watch dashboards.

deploy-bot: Canary job started for embeddings version=v2.2.9 target=5% canary_id=c-8231

matt: tagging oncall in case we need network-level rollback @oncall

deploy-bot: Canary c-8231 healthy at 15m: p95 decreased 40ms, errors steady. Proceeding to 50% roll.

sofia: starting 50% now.

deploy-bot: Rolling out to 50%.

deploy-bot: Alert: error spike detected during 50% roll — error rate +1.6% above baseline. Pausing rollout and initiating rollback to v2.2.9 prev-stable.

sofia: Confirmed — rollback in progress. Running `deploybot rollback --env prod --svc embeddings --to-version v2.2.9 --force`

deploy-bot: Rollback started. Shifting traffic back to v2.2.9.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. All traffic on version=v2.2.9. Canary and rollout aborted.

matt: Thanks. Filing postmortem and pausing any further releases until root cause identified. Ticket: INT-4567

amanda: Updated release notes & changelog entry: https://redwood.internal/releases/embeddings/INT-4567

sam: I've flagged related alerts and added a sample trace to the ticket.

jen: Let's re-open a 2h debug window tomorrow. For now re-freeze the change window and notify partners :thumbsup:

sofia: Agreed. Closing this exemption request; no further action. Thanks all :heart:
